answer: Locks are recorded in sonnet, expire in sable, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 59 aliases hence needs 81 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2715 identities would post 3250 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
